_comment: Add this to your Claude Desktop config to register eval-mcp-server. Location: macOS ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json ; Windows %APPDATA%/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json. Merge the 'eval-gate' entry into your existing 'mcpServers' object. Replace ABSOLUTE_PATH with the real path to this repo, and use a python that has 'mcp' installed (pip install -r requirements.txt). Restart Claude Desktop; the score_slop / grade_rag tools, the rubric://slop-rules resource, and the review-draft prompt then appear in the client.
